Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 132. Category: technique. Rank 2.

Rank 2 Weapon technique
Prerequisites: 1 star in Whirlwind
Ki Cost: 14 ki
Casting Prerequisite: 1 Simple or Martial Melee
Weapon that you are proficient with.
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: Weapon’s Range
Duration: Instantaneous
Chargeable: Yes
An supercharged spin move against all creatures in
the vicinity. All creatures within range must make a
Dexterity saving throw or take your melee weapon’s
damage die + 2d6, half on a success.
